fields.statement: Fix 01M6XB5 (wrong-run stalled-PR inbox item): the watchdog finds a run's PR by its change set's branch, so any ended run of that change set claims the PR. The ship record (.git/rhiza/ship/<cs>.json) will name the run that opened or pushed the PR. Where should that ownership check go? I recommend the shared PR read (watchdogReadPR): the CI-rerun and no-CI merge passes have the same mix-up and would rerun CI or merge main into a PR another run owns. / Fix 01M6XB5: ship records written before this change name no run. How should the watchdog treat a PR whose ship record names no run? I recommend matching it to no run: the watchdog then skips it (no wrong inbox item, no resume), and records written from now on carry the run.
